description: Use when mapping country attention now or by past hour. Sums news scores for 24h movers, capped at 100 per market. Default scope is cross-venue totals sources. All-source volume omits play money. See `volume_unavailable` for missing figures.

at.description: 'now' (live cache) or an ISO-8601 timestamp for a past hourly frame.

source.description: Venue ID for at=now. See get_status for public IDs.

name: map_heat
title: Country heat map
